_description: Solar System tableau against the real Milky Way. Equirectangular starfield environment. Earth + Moon pair mid-ground, Mars closer/left, Jupiter large in the back. A single strong warm 'sun' key light from screen-right casts hard day/night terminators on every textured sphere.

lights._comment: the SUN — strong warm key from far screen-LEFT and slightly toward camera, so the lit limbs are bold crescents/half-faces with hard terminators
faint cool starlight fill so night sides keep subtle relief, not pure black

objects._comment: === JUPITER — huge, deep back-right, anchors the frame ===
=== MOON — small companion to the lower-right of Earth, nearer camera ===
=== MARS — closer, lower-left, medium, fills the bottom-left third ===
